openQuestions.question: Does boarding cost anything besides the wait and the ride (no fare is stated)? Can any person ride, or is the cell only, and are there limits for a wanted or recognised cell?
openQuestions.why: GDD §02 prices boarding in time only; anything further is undecided and not set in the timetable.

openQuestions.question: Can a cell be seen or reported while waiting on a platform or riding, which would add Trail or Alert risk to the time price?
openQuestions.why: Watchers stand at stations and stops, but the GDD does not say whether boarding is a witnessed act.

openQuestions.question: Do the trams and sky rail run through the whole mission clock, including the 5:40 to 8:00 handover window, and do they change with Alert or lockdown?
openQuestions.why: Headways are assumed constant; the GDD does not say service changes, and the plan questions raise the police sealing stations.

notes: Trams T1, T2, T3 run at 8 m/s (about 29 km/h): stops are 300 to 310 m apart, so a run takes about 38 to 40 s, short but readable. [S]
S1 sky rail runs at 14 m/s (about 50 km/h): an elevated trunk with 200 to 255 m station gaps, faster than the trams, so it pays as the cross-city link. [S]
Dwell is 20 s on trams and 15 s on the sky rail. It is paid only at pass-through stops, so it affects journeys of 3 or more stops. [S]
Headways are 120 s for trams and 90 s for the sky rail, because the trunk runs more often. Average wait is half a headway, so boarding costs 45 to 60 s before the ride. [S]
Interchange pairs used: T1/circus-S1/circus, T2/harbour-S1/harbour, T3/sunset-S1/sunset, T1/comet-T2/comet. Each pair is within the 150 m standard.
Journeys cover the likely cross-city trips, including Rocket Lane (the getaway street) to Harbour Lane. Speeds, dwells and legs are unchanged from last round.
